name: The Fool
caption: Ang Tropa na Walang Plan B
meaning: fresh start, spontaneity, and trusting the journey
essence: May bagong simula. Excited ka na, wala ka pang plano, at somehow confident ka pa rin. Main character energy o impulsive decision? Abangan.
guidance: Go lang, bes, pero silipin muna kung may bangin. Hindi porke may sign from the universe, kailangan mong mag-resign bukas.

name: The Magician
caption: Manifesting pero may resibo
meaning: resourcefulness, skill, focus, and turning ideas into action
essence: Nasa iyo na ang tools, talent, at diskarte. Ang kulang na lang ay gawin mo talaga—hindi puro Pinterest board ng future success.
guidance: Manifestation is cute, pero pakigalaw ang baso. I-open ang laptop at tapusin ang isang bagay.

name: The High Priestess
caption: Seen-zoned ng sariling intuition
meaning: intuition, hidden knowledge, and the wisdom of silence
essence: May kutob kang malakas pa sa Wi-Fi ng kapitbahay. Hindi lahat kailangang i-post; minsan tahimik ka lang habang nag-o-observe ng kalat.
guidance: Trust your gut, pero huwag gawing witness ang imagination. Hintayin ang resibo bago mag-conclude.

name: The Empress
caption: Main character na may sariling garden
meaning: abundance, nurturing, creativity, and receiving
essence: Abundance ang energy mo. Parang may sariling garden, sariling budget, at sariling standards—sana pati tulog mo alagaan mo.
guidance: Alagaan ang sarili gaya ng pag-aalaga mo sa taong hindi naman nagre-reply. Hydrate, rest, at mag-no kung kailangan.

name: The Emperor
caption: CEO ng sariling buhay, may boundaries
meaning: structure, stability, authority, and healthy boundaries
essence: Ikaw ang boss ng buhay mo, pero hindi lahat ng tao empleyado mo. Structure, boundaries, at konting less power trip.
guidance: Magplano at panindigan ang boundaries. Hindi mo kailangang mag-issue ng memo sa lahat para lang respetuhin ka.

name: The Hierophant
caption: Tita na may unsolicited wisdom
meaning: tradition, learning, mentorship, and shared values
essence: May lesson na puwedeng manggaling sa elders, mentor, o tita sa reunion na may unsolicited TED Talk.
guidance: Makinig sa advice, pero i-filter. Hindi porke may edad ang nagsabi, automatic tama na ang chika.

name: The Lovers
caption: Soft launch o hard launch?
meaning: connection, alignment, meaningful choice, and values
essence: May connection o choice na kailangan ng alignment. Kilig is nice, pero consistency ang tunay na love language.
guidance: Kung puro mixed signals, baka traffic light yan, hindi soulmate. Piliin ang taong malinaw ang intensyon.

name: The Chariot
caption: Move in silence, slay in public
meaning: determination, momentum, discipline, and directed will
essence: May momentum ka. Nasa driver seat ka na—sana hindi ka nagmamaneho habang nakikipag-away sa comment section.
guidance: Focus sa goal. Iwas muna sa distractions; hindi lahat ng issue kailangan mong salihan, kahit may screenshot ka.

name: Strength
caption: Gentle pero hindi doormat
meaning: inner courage, patience, compassion, and self-mastery
essence: Soft ka pero hindi ka welcome mat. Kaya mong maging mabait nang hindi pumapayag na gawing doormat.
guidance: Huminga bago mag-reply. Hindi lahat ng nakakainis kailangan ng 12-paragraph response at matching voice note.

name: The Hermit
caption: Offline muna, nagre-recharge ang social battery
meaning: reflection, solitude, inner guidance, and seeking wisdom
essence: Kailangan mo ng alone time. Hindi ka suplada; naka-airplane mode lang ang kaluluwa mo.
guidance: Magpahinga at mag-disconnect. Hindi attendance sa lahat ng ganap ang sukatan ng friendship.

name: Wheel of Fortune
caption: Plot twist na walang spoiler alert
meaning: cycles, change, turning points, and changing circumstances
essence: Plot twist! Umiikot ang wheel at hindi ka tinanong kung ready ka. Life really said: surprise, beh!
guidance: Mag-adjust, huwag mag-panic. Hindi mo hawak ang lahat ng pangyayari, pero hawak mo ang next move mo.

name: Justice
caption: Resibo reveal, facts over feelings
meaning: fairness, truth, accountability, and balanced decisions
essence: Resibo season. Facts, fairness, at accountability ang bida. Walang lusot ang 'trust me, bro'.
guidance: I-check ang details bago magdesisyon. Kung may mali, own it; kung may mali sila, huwag kang mag-gaslight sa sarili.

name: The Hanged Man
caption: Naka-pause ang life, buffering lang
meaning: pause, surrender, patience, and a new perspective
essence: Naka-pause ang loading screen ng buhay mo. Nakakainip, oo, pero baka may update na ini-install.
guidance: Huwag pilitin ang timing. Puwedeng magpahinga nang hindi sumusuko—hindi ka microwave na kailangang instant.

name: Death
caption: Character development, hindi katapusan
meaning: endings, transformation, release, and renewal
essence: May chapter na kailangang i-end. Hindi lahat ng bagay deserve ng reunion tour, lalo na ang toxic na plotline.
guidance: Bitawan ang tapos na. Hindi ka required mag-stay dahil lang matagal ka nang nandiyan.

name: Temperance
caption: Balance beh, hindi lahat urgent
meaning: moderation, patience, integration, and healing
essence: Balance ang kailangan. Hindi lahat emergency, at hindi lahat ng notification ay utos ng hari.
guidance: Dahan-dahan lang. Hindi ka octopus na may eight hands at unlimited energy. Pumili ng priorities.

name: The Devil
caption: Red flag na, pinili mo pa rin? Gising, bes.
meaning: attachment, temptation, unhealthy patterns, and reclaiming agency
essence: May attachment o habit na parang ex: alam mong stress, pero chine-check mo pa rin profile.
guidance: Kilalanin ang pattern at maglagay ng boundary. Kung paulit-ulit kang nauubos, baka hindi yan passion project.

name: The Tower
caption: Nabuwag ang delulu headquarters
meaning: sudden change, revelation, disruption, and rebuilding
essence: Plot twist na walang warning. May illusion na mababasag at may katotohanang lalabas kahit naka-mute ka.
guidance: Kapag may gumuho, huwag mag-panic-post. Tingnan muna ang facts at buuin ulit ang mas matibay.

name: The Star
caption: Healing era, may konting glow-up
meaning: hope, renewal, inspiration, and quiet faith
essence: May pag-asa at healing. Hindi man overnight ang glow-up, at least hindi na same old episode.
guidance: I-celebrate ang small wins. Progress pa rin kahit hindi pang-before-and-after ang itsura.

name: The Moon
caption: Overthink Olympics: gold medalist
meaning: uncertainty, dreams, intuition, and unclear information
essence: Maraming what if sa utak mo. May sariling writers' room ang overthinking mo, at lahat sila puyat.
guidance: Huwag gawing teleserye ang isang seen. Ask, verify, then decide. Hindi lahat ng hinala ay plot twist.

name: The Sun
caption: Vitamin D at good news energy
meaning: joy, clarity, confidence, and vitality
essence: Good vibes, clarity, at wins! Finally, hindi puro character development—may reward episode din.
guidance: I-enjoy ang good news. Tanggapin ang compliment nang hindi sinasagot ng 'ay wala lang yun'.

name: Judgement
caption: Wake-up call, bes. Answer the group chat
meaning: awakening, reflection, reckoning, and a new call
essence: Wake-up call na may kasamang sound effect. Panahon nang matuto sa old choices at tigilan ang same episode.
guidance: Harapin ang lesson. Hindi ka mapapagalitan ng universe, pero baka kailangan mo nang i-unfollow ang bad habit.

name: The World
caption: Achievement unlocked, pak na pak
meaning: completion, integration, accomplishment, and wholeness
essence: Achievement unlocked! Natapos mo ang level kahit ilang beses kang muntik mag-quit at mag-delete ng lahat.
guidance: I-celebrate ang sarili. Deserve mo ang pahinga at konting yabang—earned naman, bes.

name: Ace of Wands
caption: May apoy ang pangarap, bes. Sana may follow-through.
meaning: inspiration, creative spark, and a new beginning
essence: May spark ka na gustong gawing project, pero kailangan ng unang actual move. Hindi pa launch ang pag-iisip ng logo, mhie.
guidance: Pumili ng isang idea at bigyan ng oras ngayong linggo. Start small bago mag-grand opening sa Facebook.

name: Two of Wands
caption: Huwag puro announce, may execution dapat.
meaning: planning, future vision, and choosing a direction
essence: Malaki ang pangarap pero nasa planning stage ka pa. Nasa kamay mo ang mapa—ikaw ang pipili kung aling pinto ang bubuksan.
guidance: Mag-research, magkumpara ng options, at magtakda ng deadline sa decision.

name: Three of Wands
caption: Creative era mo na, hindi lang bagong hobby kada sweldo.
meaning: expansion, foresight, and progress beyond your comfort zone
essence: May nasimulan ka nang effort at oras nang palawakin ang reach. Hindi na sapat ang puro local applause.
guidance: I-follow up ang opportunities at mag-isip ng next market o next step.

name: Four of Wands
caption: Ikaw ang project manager ng sariling plot twist.
meaning: celebration, belonging, and a stable foundation
essence: May dahilan para mag-celebrate: community, milestone, o moment na puwedeng i-enjoy nang walang guilt.
guidance: I-share ang win sa mga taong tunay na sumuporta. Mark the milestone bago habulin ang kasunod.

name: Five of Wands
caption: May challenge, pero hindi ka naman paper straw.
meaning: competition, friction, and clashing priorities
essence: Maraming energy pero kanya-kanyang gustong bida. Competition can sharpen you, pero puwede ring maging ingay.
guidance: Linawin ang goal at huwag gawing personal ang bawat disagreement. Piliin ang laban na may saysay.

name: Six of Wands
caption: Progress check: may nasimulan ka na ba talaga?
meaning: victory, public recognition, and earned confidence
essence: May recognition na puwedeng dumating dahil pinaghirapan mo ito. Hindi yabang ang tumanggap ng credit kapag deserve mo.
guidance: Own your achievement, then use the momentum to set the next target.

name: Seven of Wands
caption: Madaming options, pili ka muna bago mag-overthink.
meaning: defending your position, resilience, and healthy boundaries
essence: May kailangang ipaglaban o protektahan. Hindi lahat ng criticism ay attack, pero hindi rin lahat dapat palampasin.
guidance: Stand your ground with evidence and boundaries. Huwag ubusin ang sarili sa bawat comment.

name: Eight of Wands
caption: Disiplina muna bago victory dance.
meaning: swift movement, momentum, and fast communication
essence: Biglang bilis ng pangyayari: messages, travel, updates, o opportunities na sunod-sunod.
guidance: Sumagot nang malinaw at ayusin ang priorities para hindi ka malunod sa notifications.

name: Nine of Wands
caption: Konting push pa, huwag mag-quit sa loading screen.
meaning: perseverance, guarded hope, and the final stretch
essence: Pagod ka na pero hindi ka pa sumusuko. May dahilan kung bakit naka-guard ka, pero hindi lahat ng tao kalaban.
guidance: Magpahinga at piliin kung aling boundary ang kailangan. Hindi kailangang laging naka-defense mode.

name: Ten of Wands
caption: May result ang effort, hindi puro motivational quote.
meaning: burden, responsibility, and the need to release excess weight
essence: Sobra na ang pasan mo. Kahit kaya mong buhatin, hindi ibig sabihin ikaw lang ang dapat gumawa.
guidance: I-delegate, magbawas ng commitments, at sabihin kung ano ang hindi na sustainable.

name: Page of Wands
caption: Curious ka sa bagong idea—subukan, huwag puro save sa bookmarks.
meaning: enthusiasm, exploration, and a creative beginning
essence: May exciting na idea o invitation na parang gusto mong habulin agad. Beginner energy ito, hindi pa expert status.
guidance: Subukan muna at matuto habang ginagawa. Huwag mangako ng higit sa kaya mong tapusin.

name: Knight of Wands
caption: Go-getter energy, pero huwag kalimutan ang tubig at tulog.
meaning: bold action, adventure, and restless ambition
essence: Ang bilis ng apoy mo—passionate, adventurous, pero puwedeng mawala rin kapag boring na.
guidance: Tapusin ang sinimulan at isipin ang epekto ng impulsive decisions bago sumabak.

name: Queen of Wands
caption: Creative boss energy, with boundaries.
meaning: confidence, magnetism, and creative leadership
essence: May charisma at creative confidence ka. Kaya mong mag-lead nang hindi kailangang agawan ng spotlight ang iba.
guidance: Ipakita ang talent mo at suportahan din ang team. Confidence looks better with generosity.

name: King of Wands
caption: Leadership era: lead by example, hindi puro all caps sa GC.
meaning: vision, entrepreneurship, and inspiring leadership
essence: Hindi lang ikaw ang may idea; kaya mong gawing direksyon ang vision ng buong team.
guidance: Maglatag ng malinaw na plano at panagutan ang execution, hindi puro pep talk.

name: Ace of Cups
caption: Soft heart, pero may standards dapat.
meaning: emotional openness, compassion, and a fresh connection
essence: May bagong emotional opening: crush, friendship, apology, o creative feeling na hindi mo inaasahan.
guidance: Maging open pero dahan-dahan. Tingnan kung may consistency bago ibigay ang buong puso.

name: Two of Cups
caption: May feelings, may feelings. Pero nasaan ang consistency?
meaning: mutual attraction, partnership, and emotional reciprocity
essence: May mutual understanding o partnership na puwedeng lumalim. Hindi one-sided ang energy rito.
guidance: Makipag-usap nang tapat at siguraduhing pareho kayong may ambag.

name: Three of Cups
caption: Three's a crowd, lalo na kung third party ang overthinking.
meaning: friendship, celebration, and joyful community
essence: May reunion, celebration, o kaibigang nagpapagaan ng araw. Social support ang lucky charm mo ngayon.
guidance: Lumabas at makipag-connect, pero huwag kalimutang maglaan ng oras sa sarili.

name: Four of Cups
caption: Emotional balance muna bago mag-send ng paragraph.
meaning: apathy, contemplation, and overlooked opportunities
essence: May offer o opportunity sa harap mo pero parang wala kang gana. Baka pagod ka, baka hindi ito ang gusto mo.
guidance: Magpahinga at alamin kung boredom o tunay na disinterest ang dahilan bago tumanggi.

name: Five of Cups
caption: Hindi lahat ng lungkot kailangan i-story.
meaning: disappointment, grief, and the possibility of emotional recovery
essence: May lungkot dahil hindi natuloy ang inaasahan. Natural magluksa, pero hindi lang pagkawala ang buong kuwento.
guidance: Bigyan ng space ang feelings at pansinin kung anong support ang nandiyan pa rin.

name: Six of Cups
caption: Healing era, hindi stalking era.
meaning: nostalgia, kindness, and memories from the past
essence: May alaala o taong mula sa nakaraan na bumabalik. Sweet ang nostalgia, pero hindi ibig sabihing dapat ulitin lahat.
guidance: Balikan ang magandang lesson, hindi automatic ang pagbabalik sa dating setup.

name: Seven of Cups
caption: Pakinggan ang puso, pero i-check din ang facts.
meaning: many possibilities, fantasy, and the need for discernment
essence: Ang daming choices at fantasy scenarios. Ang hirap pumili kapag lahat nasa imagination pa lang.
guidance: Ihiwalay ang realistic option sa wishful thinking. Humingi ng facts bago mag-commit.

name: Eight of Cups
caption: May love, pero may self-respect din.
meaning: walking away, emotional searching, and seeking deeper fulfillment
essence: May aalisin o lalayuan ka kahit may emotional attachment pa. Hindi lahat ng mahalaga ay meant to stay.
guidance: Tanggapin kung ano ang hindi na nagbibigay ng fulfillment at planuhin ang next step.

name: Nine of Cups
caption: Feelings are valid; assumptions need receipts.
meaning: contentment, wishes fulfilled, and emotional satisfaction
essence: May wish o personal win na malapit o nararamdaman mo na. Enjoy the good thing without moving the goalpost.
guidance: Kilalanin ang satisfaction at huwag ikumpara ang timeline mo sa iba.

name: Ten of Cups
caption: Emotional maturity: hindi seen zone ang coping mechanism.
meaning: lasting happiness, emotional harmony, and family connection
essence: May larawan ng harmony, chosen family, o relationship na nagbibigay ng tunay na belonging.
guidance: Alagaan ang connection sa pamamagitan ng oras, honesty, at mutual care.

name: Page of Cups
caption: New connection? Cute. Dahan-dahan lang, bes.
meaning: romance, sensitivity, and a heartfelt message
essence: May sweet message, apology, o creative idea na nagsisimula pa lang. Cute, pero huwag munang gumawa ng wedding hashtag.
guidance: Pakinggan ang feelings at alamin kung may maturity sa likod ng gesture.

name: Knight of Cups
caption: Romantic gesture is nice; accountability is nicer.
meaning: romantic pursuit, charm, and following the heart
essence: May romantic invitation o idealistic offer. Maganda ang words, pero actions ang audition.
guidance: Enjoy the gesture while checking whether the person follows through.

name: Queen of Cups
caption: Queen of cups pero hindi free therapist ng lahat.
meaning: empathy, intuition, and compassionate understanding
essence: Malakas ang empathy mo at kaya mong damhin ang hindi sinasabi. Pero hindi mo kailangang saluhin lahat.
guidance: Pakinggan ang iba nang hindi kinakalimutan ang sariling emotional limits.

name: King of Cups
caption: King energy: emotionally available, hindi emotionally missing.
meaning: emotional balance, wisdom, and steady compassion
essence: Kalmado ka kahit emotional ang paligid. Marunong kang makinig nang hindi agad nagpapadala sa drama.
guidance: Lead with emotional maturity, but say what you need instead of pretending nothing hurts.

name: Ace of Swords
caption: Overthinking has entered the chat.
meaning: clarity, truth, and a decisive new idea
essence: May malinaw na idea o truth na puwedeng magbukas ng bagong chapter. Diretso ang usapan, wala nang paligoy-ligoy.
guidance: Isulat ang facts at sabihin ang kailangan mong sabihin nang malinaw at patas.

name: Two of Swords
caption: Facts muna bago bardagulan.
meaning: indecision, stalemate, and blocked communication
essence: May decision kang iniiwasan dahil parehong may kapalit. Ang hindi pagpili ay choice rin, bes.
guidance: Kunin ang kulang na impormasyon at magtakda ng oras para magdesisyon.

name: Three of Swords
caption: May truth na masakit, pero mas masakit ang fake news.
meaning: heartbreak, painful truth, and emotional separation
essence: May masakit na realization o disappointment. Hindi kailangang magpanggap na okay ka agad.
guidance: Harapin ang katotohanan, humingi ng support, at huwag gawing permanent identity ang sakit.

name: Four of Swords
caption: Piliin ang battles, hindi lahat ng comment kailangan sagutin.
meaning: rest, recovery, and mental stillness
essence: Kailangan ng pahinga ng isip. Hindi lahat ng silence ay avoidance; minsan recovery talaga.
guidance: Magpahinga bago sumagot o magdesisyon. I-mute muna ang ingay kung kailangan.

name: Five of Swords
caption: Brain online, peace offline.
meaning: hollow victory, tension, and conflict driven by ego
essence: May conflict na ang panalo ay baka mas mahal pa kaysa sa prize. Ego ang gustong mag-trophy.
guidance: Tanungin kung worth it ang argument. Umalis sa laban na puro damage ang ending.

name: Six of Swords
caption: Decision time: bawas 'what if', dagdag facts.
meaning: transition, moving on, and calmer waters
essence: May transition palayo sa magulong situation. Hindi instant happy ending, pero mas tahimik ang biyahe.
guidance: Dalhin ang lesson, iwan ang unnecessary baggage, at tanggapin ang gradual progress.

name: Seven of Swords
caption: Boundaries are not personal attacks, beh.
meaning: secrecy, strategy, and the risk of deception
essence: May information na hindi buong-buo o may taong hindi transparent. Strategy is useful; deception is costly.
guidance: I-verify ang details at huwag mag-share ng plano sa taong hindi pa trusted.

name: Eight of Swords
caption: May clarity kapag tumigil ka sa pag-assume.
meaning: restriction, self-doubt, and a way out through perspective
essence: Pakiramdam mo trapped ka, pero may ilang limitasyon na gawa ng takot o assumptions.
guidance: Ilista ang actual constraints at isang maliit na bagay na kaya mong kontrolin ngayon.

name: Nine of Swords
caption: Huwag mag-reply habang gigil; draft muna sa notes.
meaning: anxiety, worry, and mental overload
essence: Overthinking ang nagpapatakbo ng midnight shift sa utak mo. Hindi lahat ng worst-case scenario ay prophecy.
guidance: I-ground ang sarili sa facts at kausapin ang taong mapagkakatiwalaan kung mabigat na.

name: Ten of Swords
caption: Truth hurts, pero mas mahal ang peace of mind.
meaning: painful ending, betrayal, and the chance to begin again
essence: May ending na masakit pero hindi na puwedeng i-negotiate. Tapos na ang cycle kahit gusto pang mag-appeal ng puso.
guidance: Huwag habulin ang taong o sitwasyong malinaw nang tapos. Unahin ang recovery.

name: Page of Swords
caption: Curious mind, pero huwag gawing interrogation ang date.
meaning: curiosity, observation, and learning through questions
essence: May curiosity at bagong impormasyon. Matalas ang mata mo, pero huwag gawing surveillance project ang lahat.
guidance: Magtanong nang maayos, mag-fact-check, at maging bukas sa correction.

name: Knight of Swords
caption: Speak clearly, hindi cryptic post ang communication.
meaning: ambition, swift action, and blunt communication
essence: Mabilis ang isip at diretso ang kilos. Puwedeng maging effective, puwede ring makasakit kapag walang preno.
guidance: Bago mag-send, basahin ulit ang message. Be decisive, not reckless.

name: Queen of Swords
caption: Sharp mind, soft delivery. Kaya yan.
meaning: discernment, independence, and clear boundaries
essence: Kaya mong makita ang inconsistency at putulin ang kalituhan. Hindi mo kailangang maging cruel para maging clear.
guidance: Magtakda ng boundaries at magsalita nang honest pero may respeto.

name: King of Swords
caption: Wise decisions, hindi winning every argument.
meaning: intellectual authority, fairness, and strategic judgment
essence: May authority ka sa facts at logic. Ang tunay na leadership ay patas, hindi lang mahusay makipagtalo.
guidance: Magdesisyon gamit ang evidence at panagutan ang consequences.

name: Ace of Pentacles
caption: Budget reveal: nasaan na ang sweldo?
meaning: a tangible opportunity, prosperity, and a grounded new start
essence: May practical opportunity: trabaho, pera, training, o project na puwedeng lumago kung aalagaan.
guidance: Suriin ang terms at gumawa ng realistic first step. Small beginnings count.

name: Two of Pentacles
caption: Manifesting wealth pero may spreadsheet dapat.
meaning: adaptability, juggling priorities, and financial balance
essence: Sabay mong hinahawakan ang maraming responsibilidad. Impressive ang juggling, pero nakakapagod ang walang schedule.
guidance: Gumawa ng budget at priority list. Hindi lahat puwedeng urgent at important.

name: Three of Pentacles
caption: Small steps, malaking adulting energy.
meaning: teamwork, craftsmanship, and recognition for skill
essence: May magandang resulta kapag nagtutulungan ang tamang tao. Skill mo ang puhunan, feedback ang upgrade.
guidance: Humingi ng input at linawin ang roles para hindi ikaw ang gumagawa ng lahat.

name: Four of Pentacles
caption: Stable era, hindi impulsive checkout era.
meaning: saving, control, and fear of losing stability
essence: Kumakapit ka sa security—pera, control, o comfort zone. Protection is good until it becomes a cage.
guidance: Mag-ipon nang may plano pero huwag hayaang fear ang magdesisyon sa lahat.

name: Five of Pentacles
caption: Invest in yourself, hindi sa budol na di mo kailangan.
meaning: financial hardship, isolation, and seeking support
essence: May pakiramdam ng kakulangan o exclusion. Hindi ito sukatan ng worth mo at may tulong na puwedeng lapitan.
guidance: Maging honest sa needs at humingi ng practical support. Hindi kahinaan ang magtanong.

name: Six of Pentacles
caption: Slow progress is still progress, bes.
meaning: generosity, shared resources, and fair exchange
essence: May give-and-take na kailangang maging patas. Baka ikaw ang laging nagbibigay o laging umaasa.
guidance: Linawin ang expectations at siguraduhing healthy ang exchange.

name: Seven of Pentacles
caption: Work smart, hindi puro puyat.
meaning: patience, long-term investment, and evaluating progress
essence: May tanim kang hinihintay mamunga. Frustrating ang delay, pero kailangan ding suriin kung tama ang strategy.
guidance: Sukatin ang progress at mag-adjust kung kinakailangan. Huwag maghintay nang walang plano.

name: Eight of Pentacles
caption: May opportunity, basahin muna ang fine print.
meaning: apprenticeship, diligence, and mastery through repetition
essence: Skill ang puhunan at practice ang sikreto. Hindi viral shortcut ang kailangan kundi consistent na gawa.
guidance: Maglaan ng focused practice time at pagbutihin ang isang skill kada cycle.

name: Nine of Pentacles
caption: Practical magic: bayaran muna ang bills.
meaning: self-sufficiency, earned comfort, and personal success
essence: May independence at comfort na bunga ng sariling effort. Enjoy the freedom na pinaghirapan mo.
guidance: I-celebrate ang progress at panatilihin ang habits na nagbigay sa'yo ng stability.

name: Ten of Pentacles
caption: Savings account wants to know your location.
meaning: legacy, long-term wealth, and family stability
essence: Ang choices mo ngayon may epekto sa long-term security o pamilya. Hindi lang instant win ang usapan.
guidance: Mag-isip beyond this month: savings, shared plans, at sustainable commitments.

name: Page of Pentacles
caption: New skill unlocked, dagdag value sa sarili.
meaning: study, practical ambition, and a new financial skill
essence: Beginner mode sa practical goal: bagong course, budget habit, o career opportunity.
guidance: Mag-aral, magtanong, at gumawa ng maliit na routine para maging real ang potential.

name: Knight of Pentacles
caption: Consistency ang tunay na financial glow-up.
meaning: reliability, patience, and consistent effort
essence: Slow but steady ang approach. Hindi flashy, pero mapagkakatiwalaan kapag may commitment.
guidance: Panindigan ang routine at huwag magmadali sa result na kailangan ng panahon.

name: Queen of Pentacles
caption: Boss energy with a budget tracker.
meaning: practical care, resourcefulness, and grounded abundance
essence: Marunong kang mag-alaga ng resources at tao nang hindi nakakalimot sa practicality.
guidance: I-balance ang generosity at sariling needs. Secure your base bago tumulong nang sobra.

name: King of Pentacles
caption: Abundance is cute; financial literacy is cuter.
meaning: financial leadership, prosperity, and responsible stewardship
essence: May potential kang magpatakbo ng stable na system o negosyo. Hindi lang pera ang sukatan—kasama ang integrity.
guidance: Gumawa ng long-term plan at maging responsible sa resources at taong umaasa sa'yo.
